response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced, versatile senior engineer with 15+ years across web, backend, embedded and some high-throughput systems, plus strong community teaching and open-source leadership. However, the role's core minimum bar — 8 years of C++ programming — is not met; his C/C++ exposure is limited to roughly six months at National Instruments and a university thesis project. His career centers on TypeScript/Node.js, D, and product/web engineering rather than large-scale cloud compute platform infrastructure, and he has no documented formal technical-leadership role owning platform strategy or mentoring cloud/DevOps engineers. The gap between his profile and the C++/large-scale-infrastructure requirements is too large to justify an interview for this specific position.
strengths: Low-latency, high-throughput distributed systems work at Sociomantic/Dunnhumby
Strong engineering-practice culture: TDD, CI/CD, tooling, open-source project ownership
Proven mentoring and knowledge-sharing via workshops, courses, and conference talks
concerns: C++ experience far below the 8-year minimum (~6 months)
Limited large-scale cloud compute platform or infrastructure ownership
No formal technical lead role managing priorities, roadmaps, or cloud/DevOps engineers
